notes: Lead: SpruceRoot runs a small DTC ecommerce stack (12 engineers + 6 customer ops).
Primary ask: replace heuristic FAQ + rules with single chat endpoint embedded in storefront and admin console.
POC goals: 1) checkout assistant (sensitive intent), 2) product recommendation snippets, 3) short order-summary email drafts.
Performance constraints: target median generation latency <= 250ms for UI chat; willing to accept 400ms for non-UX flows.
Traffic: expected steady 800-1,200 requests/day, peak ~80-120 reqs/min during sale windows — low concurrency overall.
Cost sensitivity: high. Founders want predictable $/month cap. Prefer model suggestions that balance quality vs token cost.
Model preferences discussed: team asked about Llama 2 13B vs Mistral 7B vs Qwen 7B variants — asked for concrete quality vs cost guidance.
Quoted from CTO Sam Li: "We need checkout flows to be near-human accuracy on price/promos — happy to pay for quality there, but internal drafts must be cheap."
Architecture notes: will use hosted API initially; may consider Dedicated later if traffic grows or data residency required.
Security: need SSO integration for internal admin console and audit log retention for order edits for 90 days.

Suggested Redwood pattern: route purchase-intent prompts to higher-quality model (e.g., Llama 2 13B or quantized 13B variant) and route general chit-chat to Mistral/Qwen 7B cheap variants; use prefix caching for product descriptions.
POC plan: compare two families across three dimensions — perceived accuracy (QA checklist), token cost per session, median latency.
MVP success criteria: reduce support deflection by 20% on FAQ flows; checkout assistance accuracy >= 95% on sampled test prompts.
Internal blocker: Finance needs monthly cap on hosted spend before exec approval.
